issue.title: resource/aws_secretsmanager_secret_version: `secret_string_wo_version` documented as Optional but enforced as required when `secret_string_wo` is set
issue.body:
## Description

The documentation for [`aws_secretsmanager_secret_version`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/secretsmanager_secret_version#secret_string_wo_version-2) lists `secret_string_wo_version` as **Optional**:

> `secret_string_wo_version` - (Optional) Attribute used to trigger updates when rotating `secret_string_wo`.

However, in practice, whenever `secret_string_wo` is set, the provider **requires** `secret_string_wo_version` to also be present. Omitting it causes a plan-time error:

```
Error: Missing required argument

  with aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.example,
  on main.tf line N, in resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "example":

"secret_string_wo": all of secret_string_wo,secret_string_wo_version must be specified
```

This is because the provider schema internally has `RequiredWith: []string{"secret_string_wo"}` on `secret_string_wo_version`, making it conditionally required — not truly optional.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure `aws_secretsmanager_secret_version` with `secret_string_wo` set but **without** `secret_string_wo_version`:

```hcl
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "example" {
  secret_id        = aws_secretsmanager_secret.example.id
  secret_string_wo = "my-secret-value"
}
```

2. Run `tofu plan` (or `terraform plan`)

**Expected:** Plan succeeds (since docs say Optional)
**Actual:** Plan fails with `all of secret_string_wo,secret_string_wo_version must be specified`

## Expected Behavior

The documentation should clearly state that `secret_string_wo_version` is **required when `secret_string_wo` is set**, not simply "Optional". The current wording misleads users into omitting it.

## Suggested Fix

Update the registry documentation at the `secret_string_wo_version` anchor to read:

> `secret_string_wo_version` - (Required when `secret_string_wo` is set) Attribute used to trigger updates when rotating `secret_string_wo`. Must always be specified alongside `secret_string_wo`.

## Additional Context

- Provider version: `hashicorp/aws ~> 6.43`
- Related issue: #44590 (`secret_string_wo_version` also cannot accept ephemeral values — a separate but related problem)
- This is a documentation-only clarification request; the `RequiredWith` constraint makes the "Optional" label incorrect.
